definitions.gloss: reservation system; appointment system; by reservation only
definitions.explanation: A system requiring advance booking or reservation before visiting or using a service.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予約制|よやくせい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant is by reservation only.

examples.japanese: {予約制|よやくせい}⟦な→だ：09496_da⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{事前|じぜん}→事前：07580_jizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Since it's by reservation, please call in advance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{予約制|よやくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The hospital has switched to a complete appointment system.

notes:
{予約制|よやくせい} says that a place or service is available only to people who have booked ahead. The suffix ⟦{制|せい}→制：noentry⟧ turns ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) into the name of a system, so the word describes the establishment's policy, not any one booking.

USAGE:
- As a predicate: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予約制|よやくせい}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧
- Adopting the policy: {予約制|よやくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to go over to appointments), {予約制|よやくせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{導入|どうにゅう}→導入：10127_dounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to introduce the system)
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{予約制|よやくせい} means no walk-ins at all; ⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧{予約制|よやくせい} means some capacity is held back for them

WHERE YOU MEET IT:
Clinics, ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ (hair salons), small restaurants, and popular exhibitions at ⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧. Note that ⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧ (hospital) and ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ (salon) differ by one mora, and both commonly carry this notice.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{先着順|せんちゃくじゅん}→先着順：07057_senchakujun⟧ (first-come, first-served) and ⟦{抽選|ちゅうせん}→抽選：07054_chuusen⟧ (lottery) are the alternatives when demand outstrips places.
